verdict_rules.note: No single t-statistic decides this gate. The overlapping-window caveat from the recovery mission still governs: five origins twelve months apart are roughly two effective independent return periods, so direction and robustness carry the weight.
verdict_rules.G1_INCREMENTAL_SURVIVES: ALL of: pooled b6 > 0 with clustered |t| >= 2; Fama-MacBeth mean b6 > 0; per-origin sign positive at >= 4 of 5; all five leave-one-origin-out pooled b6 > 0; within-sector rank effect positive at >= 4 of 5 origins
verdict_rules.G1_COLLAPSES_TO_FORECAST_STRIP: pooled b6 <= 0, OR (clustered |t| < 2 AND pooled b6 < 0.33 x 1.3679 = 0.4514)
verdict_rules.G1_INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, including the case where the primary and EP paths disagree in direction
verdict_rules.collinearity_rule: A high VIF is reported, not treated as a pass or a fail on its own. If ICC cannot be separated from FEPS1/P at all — condition number implying no identification — the verdict is G1_INCONCLUSIVE and the reason is recorded as non-identification rather than collapse.
